title: Inflammatory Profile of Different Absorbable Membranes Used for Bone Regeneration: An In Vivo Study
authors: Bizelli VF, Alécio Viotto AH, Delamura IF, Baggio AMP, Ramos EU, Faverani LP, Bassi APF. Inflammatory Profile of Different Absorbable Membranes Used for Bone Regeneration: An In Vivo Study. Biomimetics (Basel). 2024 Jul 16;9(7):431.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss collprotect (porcine dermis) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “We conclude that different origins and ways of obtaining them, as well as the thickness of the membrane, can interfere with the biological response of the material” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
